name: dsh-reading-workbench
modifications: No changes to upstream source. A chapter-only in-memory WorkbenchApi implementation provides content, highlights, notes and progress.
PDF rendering is omitted from this text-only preview through a build-time component alias.
DSH theme variables are supplied in the isolated frame; no remote or host API is available.
LG chapter input is treated as plain TXT with preserve layout and the upstream serif font option.
